protocol.objective: Minute MSE targets the conditional mean; MAE targets the median and is a guard
protocol.features: Previous final-roster membership/positions, prior seasons, past game logs, same-day pre-noon report
protocol.evaluation: All archived regular-season days; target final roster only gates/scorers, never predictor eligibility
protocol.eligibility: At least8 past/current-report known teammates, >=3 previous played games for scored players, final tipoff strictly after noon cutoff
protocol.assessment: Freeze a single selection winner; assess it and baseline only. No runner-up selection on assessment.
protocol.deployment: Only if selection and assessment gates pass, using the same rotation function. Otherwise baseline.
protocol.limits: Retrospective, played-game conditional; historical Yahoo eligibility and transactions unavailable. No claim of causal injury effects or category-win lift.
protocol.rare_strong_prior_guard: Even below200 rows, reject >5% MSE harm in observed strong-prior low-role cohort; conservative point-estimate guard, not statistical proof
